decision.explanation: The question asks for the formation year of the '64th Division'. The source documents describe two distinct entities with this name: 1) The 64th (2nd Highland) Division of the British Army, which D1S2 and D1S3 state was formed in 'late 1914' and 'in 1914' respectively. 2) The 64th Division of the Imperial Japanese Army, which D2S3 and D3S3 state was formed on '1 May 1943'. As these are distinct valid referents (different armies, different times), both years are correct answers to the ambiguous query. Other documents (D4, D5, D6) refer to the 64th Air Division or 6th Wing/Division and are irrelevant to the specific '64th Division' infantry units mentioned in the primary sources.
